info.name: Asset Management POC
info.description:
Backend REST API for asset requests, approvals, allocation and returns.

How to use:
1. Start the app (default http://localhost:8080).
2. Run folder 01 first. It logs in every seeded user and stores the tokens.
3. Run the other folders in order.

Seeded logins: admin/admin123, ravi/manager123, kiran/manager123, shilpi/employee123, meera/employee123, arjun/employee123.

item.name: 03 Security - Token checks
item.description: All of these hit a protected URL and must return 401 as JSON. Needs the temporary endpoints from piece 8 for the URL to exist, but 401 is returned either way.

request.description: Basic login must not work any more. Only tokens are accepted.
Takes the saved admin token and changes its last 3 characters.

item.name: Token signed with a different key (401)

request.description: To prepare: set jwt.expiration-ms=1000, restart, log in as admin, copy the token into the collection variable expiredToken, wait 2 seconds, then set the expiry back to 3600000 and restart. Until you do, this request sends an empty token and still returns 401.
